Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. As discussed, we'd like to run a combined technical demo + pricing & packaging review so your eng, procurement, and security teams can see the tradeoffs between Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and agree on sizing needs. 

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 25 min: short end-to-end demo (AE + SE) focused on your LLM workload patterns
- 15 min: usage forecast & dedicated sizing (pricing implications)
- 5 min: next steps / mutual action plan

I attached a quick usage-forecast template to help the SE sizing call — if you can drop in the last 3 months of token/embedding volumes it will speed the discussion.

A few proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 6/30 10:00–10:45
- Wed 7/1 14:00–14:45
- Thu 7/2 09:00–09:45

Please let me know who from your side will join (eng / procurement / security) and which slot works. If procurement needs a separate follow-up, we can schedule a 30–45 min procurement-only call after the demo.

Thanks — looking forward.

Diego Fernández
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
